schema.text: In the evening or after dark, how safe do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
schema.help: We ask this to understand how safe people feel while travelling. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: I don't feel safe at all
I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel safe
I don't travel in the evening or after dark

en.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: We ask this to understand how safe people feel while travelling. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.
en.#I don't feel safe at all: I don't feel safe at all
en.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: In the evening or after dark, how safe do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
en.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel safe
en.#I don't travel in the evening or after: I don't travel in the evening or after dark

it.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Lo chiediamo per capire quanto le persone si sentono al sicuro durante gli spostamenti. Rispondere è facoltativo e la tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.
it.#I don't feel safe at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#I feel completely safe: Mi sento del tutto al sicuro
it.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Di sera o quando è buio, quanto ti senti al sicuro da criminalità o molestie durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Evito di spostarmi di sera perché non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Non mi sposto di sera o quando è buio

fr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre à quel point les gens se sentent en sécurité lors de leurs déplacements. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.
fr.#I don't feel safe at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly safe: Je me sens un peu en sécurité
fr.#I feel moderately safe: Je me sens moyennement en sécurité
fr.#I feel very safe: Je me sens très en sécurité
fr.#I feel completely safe: Je me sens totalement en sécurité
fr.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Le soir ou à la nuit tombée, à quel point vous sentez-vous en sécurité face à la criminalité ou au harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: J’évite de me déplacer le soir parce que je ne me sens pas en sécurité
fr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Je ne me déplace pas le soir ni à la nuit tombée

de.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, wie sicher sich Menschen unterwegs fühlen. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.
de.#I don't feel safe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht sicher
de.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich abends oder bei Dunkelheit auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Ich meide Wege am Abend, weil ich mich nicht sicher fühle
de.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Ich bin abends oder bei Dunkelheit nicht unterwegs

tr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Bunu, insanların yolculuk sırasında kendilerini ne kadar güvende hissettiklerini anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.
tr.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra olağan yolculuğunuzda suça veya tacize karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kendimi güvende hissetmediğim için akşamları yolculuk yapmaktan kaçınıyorum
tr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra yolculuk yapmıyorum

fa.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم مردم هنگام رفت‌وآمد چقدر احساس امنیت می‌کنند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.
fa.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: در عصر و شب یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: از رفت‌وآمد در شب پرهیز می‌کنم چون احساس امنیت نمی‌کنم
fa.#I don't travel in the evening or after: در عصر و شب یا پس از تاریکی رفت‌وآمد نمی‌کنم

hu.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mennyire érzik magukat biztonságban az emberek közlekedés közben. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és a válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.
hu.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Este vagy sötétedés után mennyire érzi magát biztonságban bűncselekményekkel vagy zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során?
hu.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kerülöm az esti közlekedést, mert nem érzem magam biztonságban
hu.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Este vagy sötétedés után nem közlekedem

ar.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم مدى شعور الناس بالأمان أثناء تنقلهم. الإجابة اختيارية وإجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.
ar.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام، إلى أي مدى تشعر بالأمان من الجريمة أو التحرش في تنقّلك المعتاد؟
ar.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: أتجنب التنقل في المساء لأنني لا أشعر بالأمان
ar.#I don't travel in the evening or after: لا أتنقل في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام
